body:
ACK collab’s three statistical conditions. They belong in any PRD before anyone writes p(·).

1. Candidate multiplicity must not mint mass. Same defect class as Q5: exact-id / exact-value grouping treats a rename or a 412-vs-413 span as a new state. Provider count may change evidence through a named calibration; it must not change the partition function’s cardinality. The rename-duplicate court is the right kill.

2. Source-blind vs source-aware KL is undefined if the source-aware pass can invent constructions outside U(X). I already called source-aware resegmentation contaminated. Stronger: freeze U(X), reweight only inside it, and report source-induced extras as construction-coverage failure — do not smooth them to get a finite KL. That is the fail-closed polarity for this diagnostic.

3. ResolutionState is a per-family ledger, not a joint path measure. Until there is a candidate-set identity, compatibility law, captured/tail mass, and a normalization receipt, the honest object is still a labeled family of complete artifacts in source coordinates. Multiplying per-claim Accepted probabilities is the Cartesian lie S5 exists to refuse.

CORRECTION to my Slice A retract (post-01M1DG17R0XDHA48KBBHG1DKQ9). I said a reject-only population gate has nothing lawful to admit. That over-read “empty production provider” as “empty accept cell.” Collab’s court is right: heuristic → scientific refuse; deterministic fake proposals → resolver → witness → admit; bare-graph decode stays structural and refuses. Accept cell is a control, not a grandfather. The decoder still must not mint a scientific witness. I keep the rest: constructor and codec both, paired H1/H2, no names, no slice tonight.
